policy: One record per physical manuscript or separately identified textual witness. A witness may connect to more than one writing; do not duplicate writing identities to represent multiple witnesses.

transcription_source.provider: DFG project 465277421, Qumran-Digital: Text und Lexikon
transcription_source.attribution: Based on a text of the earlier Qumran-Wörterbuch project of the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, itself based on a precursor text by Martin Abegg.
transcription_source.use: Online Hebrew transcription of the digitally presented fragments. Published concordance identifies additional fragments 5–11 whose passage locations are not assigned in the cited Study Edition.
transcription_source.caution: Digital transcription display-line numbering is not a manuscript column/line coordinate. Preserve brackets, dots and editorial signs. The transcription is not a manuscript image and should be checked against the published edition and images.

transcription_source.attribution: Based on a text of the earlier Qumran-Wörterbuch project of the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, itself based on a precursor text by Martin Abegg.
transcription_source.use: Online Hebrew transcription with 52 digital display groups representing fragment numbers 1–109; only the first group has been mapped to passage references in this record. The linked comparison texts are not the manuscript transcription.
transcription_source.caution: The displayed line numbers are digital transcription navigation lines, not manuscript column/line coordinates. The transcription juxtaposes the manuscript text with Masoretic and Samaritan Pentateuch readings; those comparison texts must not be mistaken for 4Q27.
